statement: Before naming another repository in a public Cejel comment or record, check its visibility with `gh repo view <owner/name> --json visibility`. Also check that public Cejel already names it, for example with a search of the public repository. A private sibling repository's name went into a public Cejel issue comment (#526). The comment had to be deleted and reposted without the name. Being reachable with the agent's own credentials says nothing about visibility: an authenticated gh call reads a private repository as easily as a public one. Rules: treat every repository name as closed until gh reports PUBLIC and public Cejel already uses it; if either check fails, describe the repository generically ("a private sibling repository"); never paste gh output or URLs that carry a private name into a public surface.
